text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: HRAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Haaah... I'm not finished yet! This is nothing compared to what City's going through.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This is starting to look pretty dire.
Despite
everything you've taught me, I
haven't succeeded
even once.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! You've improved a ton
compared
to when we began!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess I have to do everything I
can,
right? I don't want to disappoint my
fans, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Still, City does have a long ways to go before she'll be ready for the cooking show.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(What can we do to improve her omelet
game?!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(There has to be a better method! But
how can I
find it?!)
Hup! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That voice! Brimming with steadfast
spirit...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Of course it's you, Yaeno! You
never miss a
day of training, do you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is but a small effort to commit oneself
to a
routine. How goes your own
training, Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm just wrapping up an intense run,
actually. Had
some things to think
through!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, if you have the energy, care
to join
me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Realigning your spirit may help stimulate

productive contemplation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno & Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Hup! Hiyah!
Hwah! Kyah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hooooo! Sure enough, there's nothing
like martial
arts to pull yourself
together!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Once you dedicate yourself to your
training, the
winds which blow at your
heart cease, and your
mind frees itself
naturally from agitation.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... So the reason you're always on
point is
because you practice your kata
forms every day?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Katas appear rather dull when set beside
true
contest and sparring. However,
practicing
discipline and overcoming
one's weaknesses make
up the essence
of being a warrior.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Practice your katas and you may become

reacquainted with your roots.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My roots...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! What heat! What fiery passion!
City, your
heart is like a furnace, and I'm
gonna do all I can
to help you keep it
burning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Aha! That's it! The root of the problem!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the tree-lined path just
before
sunset when I spot two familiar
faces.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So that's it! No more teaching! I have to
take a
step back into a supporting role
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I got so caught up in the nuts and bolts
about
methods and skills...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But all I originally set out to do was
cheer you on
as you tried your best.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'll still lend a hand if you get
stuck or
have any technical questions.
That wouldn't be
overstepping!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's take this on with everything we've
got! I'll be
right here on the sidelines
when you need me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're right. You've used so many
ways to
teach me, I definitely know how
to cook an
omelet by now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All right. Please stick with me just a little
longer.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hraaagh! Here's a hundred squats and a
prayer
for your success making a
delicious omelet!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What? Right now?! Here?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how the squats are
supposed to help,
but Bamboo
Memory's sincerity and passion come

through loud and clear!
